name: table-viewer
title: Table Viewer
description: A table in a viewer, e.g. a CSV file (parseCsv reads RFC 4180): row numbers, each column's type under its name (numbers found, to the end), only the rows in view drawn. A cell picked by a click or the keys (arrows, Page Up and Down, Home and End); the status bar says which and a column of numbers' sum; filtered by text, sorted by the picked column, and the picked cell given to the app by @.
